name: guardrails-records
description: Documentation: leave a trail a reviewer can follow, and keep what can't be rebuilt.

cleanTreeOnDone.title: clean-tree-on-done
cleanTreeOnDone.description: When a reply says the work is finished but files edited this session are uncommitted, send it back to commit them or say so plainly.

docAgeStamp.title: doc-age-stamp
docAgeStamp.description: When a handoff, status or plan doc is read, add how old it is and how many commits have landed since.

docPatterns.title: doc-age-stamp: file names
docPatterns.description: Comma-separated file-name patterns to stamp. Empty uses HANDOFF*.md, HANDOFF*.txt, STATUS*.md, TODO*.md, NEXT*.md, PLAN*.md, *handoff*.md, *status*.md.

neverRevert.title: never-revert
neverRevert.description: Refuse edits that remove text a repo lists in its never-revert file, until you approve with the one-time code.

neverRevertFile.title: never-revert: file
neverRevertFile.description: The rules file, relative to each repo's root. One rule per line: 'exact text => why it stays'.

dbSnapshot.title: db-snapshot
dbSnapshot.description: Back up a SQLite database before a shell command writes to it. If the backup fails, the write waits for your approval.

snapshotDir.title: db-snapshot: folder
snapshotDir.description: Where snapshots go. '~' is your home folder.

snapshotKeep.title: db-snapshot: copies kept
snapshotKeep.description: Snapshots kept per database; the oldest is overwritten.

snapshotEveryMinutes.title: db-snapshot: minimum gap (minutes)
snapshotEveryMinutes.description: Skip a new snapshot if one of the same database was taken this recently.

turnLedger.title: turn-ledger
turnLedger.description: Append one line per turn: what was asked, which tools ran, which files changed.

ledgerDir.title: turn-ledger: folder
ledgerDir.description: One JSONL file per day goes here. '~' is your home folder.

ledgerPrompts.title: turn-ledger: keep prompts
ledgerPrompts.description: Record the first 200 characters of each prompt. Off records only tools and files.

approvalMinutes.title: Approval window (minutes)
approvalMinutes.description: How long an approval code stays valid after you type it.

heartbeatDir.title: Heartbeat folder
heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
